theme: An open day in St. Pete, with a Croatia backlog to clear before you fly.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — a rare open stretch, girls with you and Mike in St. Pete. The one real pull is the pile of past-due Croatia bookings before you leave on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Prep for the Valoris call
needsAttention.detail: Martin Steindl's Teams call sits at noon tomorrow. Skim Valoris Catalysts and arrive holding your read on the fit rather than working it out live.

needsAttention.title: The girls' passport packet
needsAttention.detail: Due today on the Mike + Dan board: print and assemble the DS-11s and birth-certificate copies for all four girls before Friday's appointment. One missing document sends four applications home, and State Department fees are check or money order only.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat night, Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Aug 23 on the board: one refundable night in Cavtat for Sat Sept 19, plus the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer at noon. The real deadline is Sept 8 — the charter has no connectivity to book from once aboard.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Aug 25: two nights, Sept 20-21, in the St. Pete area after you land TPA and before the Tuesday kid pickup. The Orlando villa and the later Airbnb are already handled.

needsAttention.title: Croatia checked bags
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Aug 25: the issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy online now — two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

flagged.title: Kuala Lumpur governance event
flagged.detail: Kevin Waring at CGI asks whether you'd like to come along to meet a new corporate audience; speaker slots are full but he flags it as worth the room. He leaves for Tokyo Sept 26 and no reply has gone back yet.

flagged.title: Nautilus sailing balance
flagged.detail: Invoice 2170 shows a $6,475 balance for the September course, and Amy sent a separate final-payment nudge — due ahead of the Sept 12 start.

flagged.title: Liberty Mutual renewal
flagged.detail: Your home policy renewal notice arrived this morning; worth a look before it auto-renews.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and travel confirmations — Airbnb, Enterprise, a couple of newsletters.

recipe.title: Sautéed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: High summer means zucchini and basil are at their peak, so keep it quick and fresh.

acts.line: A rare open morning — nothing on the calendar to answer to.
The afternoon is yours, settled in St. Pete with the girls.
Quiet tonight, then tomorrow's first commitment is a midday call.
